hypotheses.storyTitle: Advance Your First Home Savings Knowledge
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Continue mastering your financial literacy goals at your own pace without pressure.

hypotheses.storyTension: Maintaining steady educational momentum while avoiding high-pressure timed challenges or public rankings.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Engaging with the next learning module and tracking progress milestones privately.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Master financial literacy milestones and monitor long-term savings goal progression at an individualized pace.
